## Aristocrat Sorcerer (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 Female human aristocrat 3/sorcerer 3  
 N Medium humanoid (human)  

**Init**  +1; **Senses** Perception +8  
  
  

**Defense**

   **AC** 11, touch 11, flat-footed 10 (Dex +1)  

**hp**  54 (6d8+6)  

**Fort** +3, **Ref** +5, **Will** +6  

**Defensive Abilities** fated +1  
  
  

**Offense**

  
     **Speed** 30 ft.  

**Melee** unarmed strike +2 (1d3–1 nonlethal)  

**Bloodline Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 3rd, concentration +8)  
  8/day—touch of destiny
  

 **Spells Known**  (CL 3rd, concentration +8)  
  1st (5/day)—
      *[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*,  *[charm person](../../magic/spells/charm-person.md)* (DC 17),  *[hypnotism](../../magic/spells/hypnotism.md)* (DC 17),  *[unseen servant](../../magic/spells/unseen-servant.md)*
  
 0 (at will)—
      *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*,  *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*,  *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)* (DC 15),  *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*,  *[touch of fatigue](../../magic/spells/touch-of-fatigue.md)* (DC 15)
  

 **Bloodline**  destined  
 **Tactics**  

**During Combat** She is a poor combatant. If there is no one to protect her, she attempts to charm a likely protector and then flees combat, using *unseen servant* to close doors and move obstacles into the path of pursuers.  

**Morale** She quickly flees or gracefully surrenders if she believes she would be killed. She isn’t frightened by battle; she just understands that she has no aptitude for it.  
  

**Statistics**

     **Str** 8, **Dex** 13, **Con** 12, **Int** 14, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 20  

**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 13  

**Feats** Alertness, Eschew Materials, Lightning Reflexes, Persuasive, Spell Focus (enchantment)  

**Skills** Appraise +10, Bluff +11, Diplomacy +13, Intimidate +13, Knowledge (History) +7, Knowledge (Local) +7, Knowledge (Nobility) +7, Linguistics +7, Perception +8, Sense Motive +9, Spellcraft +7  

**Languages** Common, Draconic, Elven, Skald, +1 additional  
**SQ** bloodline arcana  

**Gear** *headband of alluring charisma* +2, noble’s outfit, 500 gp
